secondary_report.page_title: Democratic Organizer Fired After Undercover Video Alleges Overseas Donations to El-Sayed Campaign
secondary_report.date_metadata_note: Embedded modified timestamp precedes embedded published timestamp; retain both without resolving inconsistency.
secondary_report.body_summary: Article reports O’Keefe Media Group released a video Monday Oct 19 identifying Abdoul Beckwith as a regional field organizer; it attributes the statement that he had never been employed by the Senate campaign to El-Sayed campaign. It recounts Beckwith’s overseas-donation allegation as reported by OMG, quotes the campaign calling comments untrue/wildly misinformed/not reflective and claiming FEC compliance, and says OMG reported the Michigan Democratic Party terminated Beckwith. It notes overseas location alone does not establish prohibited foreign-national contributions.

relayed_denial.author: James O’Keefe (@JamesOKeefeIII), not the campaign
relayed_denial.observation: Root viewed the O’Keefe-hosted OMG/Abdul graphic: statement attributed to communications director Roxie Richner denies Beckwith was campaign-employed, rejects his comments, and asserts FEC compliance. This is a relayed denial, not a campaign-owned original or proof of either side.
